lead.en: A host-driven, read-only document and review cursor.
lead.zh: 由宿主驱动的只读文档与审核光标。

rule.en: The host supplies document blocks, target positions, run results and persistence. The preview simulates edits and saves nothing.
rule.zh: 宿主负责文档、光标目标、运行结果和持久化。预览仅模拟修改，不会保存。

api.en: Handle Run using its ticket with set_target_for, set_position_for, set_status_for and set_blocks_for; finish or fail the same ticket. Stop invalidates it and restores the original. Review exposes Accept and Undo events. set_position uses local logical pixels; set_visible controls off-screen work.
api.zh: 处理 Run 时使用 ticket 调用 set_target_for、set_position_for、set_status_for 和 set_blocks_for，再对同一 ticket 调用 finish 或 fail。Stop 使 ticket 失效并恢复原文。审核阶段提供 Accept 与 Undo 事件；set_position 使用文档内逻辑像素，set_visible 控制离屏工作。

motion.en: The cursor follows measured block targets with a spring; reduced motion jumps to the target and off-screen animation stops. Word-by-word streaming, selection effects and full reference comparison remain unimplemented or unverified.
motion.zh: 光标以弹簧跟随实测的文档块位置；减少动效时直接跳转，离屏停止动画。逐字流、选择效果及完整参考对照尚未实现或验收。
